ogee r16-p

The printed build: 124 printed parts driven by hand, or 119 on servos. Every solid here is one of the STLs off the build plate.

write a pixel

Turns that row knob and that column knob together, which is the two handed move you would actually make.

drive

The frame is the same either way: the servo brackets and latch tower tab into slots the base and deck already carry, and with knobs those slots just sit empty. Swap and the crank angles are identical, because it is the same crank.

Either bar alone lifts its rods half way and they drop back when you let go.

render

assembly

Step through the build, or pull it apart. The order is forced in one place: the row cranks sit under the deck and the column cranks over it, so the row shafts go in first.
